Vipin Kumar Mishra @ Vipin Mishra And 2 ... vs State Of U.P.
Thru. The Prin.Secy. Home ... on 10 February, 2025

Author: Karunesh Singh Pawar
Bench: Karunesh Singh Pawar
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc-Lko:8530
Court No. - 16
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 4114 of 2024
Applicant :- Vipin Kumar Mishra @ Vipin Mishra And 2 Other
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. The Prin.Secy. Home And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Tariq Khan,Km. Anjali Gautam
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Vinay Prakash Tiwari
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel
respondent no. 2.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the parties submit that vide order dated 04.12.2024, the parties were directed to appear before the Senior Registrar of this Court regarding verification of the compromise.
The petitioners as well as respondent no. 2 on 08.01.2025 appeared before the Senior Registrar of this Court and in their presence, the Senior Registrar of this Court verified the compromise.
Report to this effect is on the file of the Court.

Learned counsel for the parties submit that since the parties have amicably settled their dispute outside the Court by entering into compromise and the said compromise has been verified under the order of the Court, hence, in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of "Gian Vipin Kumar Mishra @ Vipin Mishra And 2 ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. The Prin.Secy. Home ...

entities.text: Gian Vipin Kumar Mishra @ Vipin Mishra And 2 ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. The Prin.Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Singh Vs. State of Punjab" reported in "(2012) 10 SCC 303", the proceedings impugned are liable to be quashed.
Learned A.G.A. has no objection to this prayer.
Perused the record, so also the report dated 08.01.2025 submitted by the Senior Registrar of this Court.

In view of the above and considering the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of "Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab" reported in "(2012) 10 SCC 303", as well as the fact that the compromise entered between the parties been verified by the Senior Registrar of this Court, the proceedings of Criminal Complaint No. 891/2019, "Ram Manorath Shukla Vs. Vipin Kumar and others", under sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 I.P.C. and sections 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Jagdishpur, District Amethi are hereby quashed.
